Weekday tips for anyone flying with an animal
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travel with your animal goes best when you keep the plans simple and the papers ready.

Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk checks comfort needs from booking through pickup, so tell us about your pet's size, temperament, and any special care early. <<FACT F079>> Bring the health papers in the form we ask for, use a secure carrier, and make sure food, water, and bedding are packed in a way that stays clean and calm.

If your animal seems uneasy, our welfare coordinator can help adjust the plan before travel begins. Small steps like a familiar blanket and a quiet handoff can make a real difference. If you are unsure about anything, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you arrive so we can help keep the trip smooth and safe.
